name: Returning-buyer launch continuation
hypothesis: Buy when a preselected fraction of initial buyers makes additional net purchases and price clears a completed consolidation.
spec: Setup: Repeat buying by independently funded participants may indicate continued demand. Entry: Buy when a preselected fraction of initial buyers makes additional net purchases and price clears a completed consolidation. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit when return buyers turn net sellers or consolidation support fails. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs launchpad creation events, bonding-curve state and decoded swaps (on-chain history not connected)
